name: print-social-novavista-hiring-platform-post-with-navy-grid-blocks
title: Novavista 'Trying to find the best candidates?' post in navy grid blocks with a green feature list
whatItIs: A square post divided into four blocks: navy with a big white question headline and green pill, indigo with a green N logo and short copy with a ghost 'N', white with labelled contact details (phone, email, address, website), and green with a ruled list of features (AI-Powered, Talent Analysis…).
whatItMeans: Organised and trustworthy; the grid makes a lot of information calm and scannable.
techniques: Divide the square into four functional blocks.
Put a ghost logo letter behind copy.
List features with thin dividers in a colour block.
Label contact fields in small green caps.

vocabulary.definition: A layout of rectangles each with a role.
A large faint letterform used as background.
